**describe the bug**
brief description of the bug.

Developer reports only: neither the repository owner nor Digiwise supports this
project in any way. Filing an issue does not promise a response or a fix. Do not
contact Digiwise for support.

Include a minimal synthetic reproduction and safe error/reason codes. ScreenWise
does not upload logs. Do not attach recorder databases, recordings, transcripts,
API tokens, private screenshots, raw logs or other captured content.

**system info**
- os: [e.g. macos 10.15.7, windows 10, ubuntu 20.04]
- ScreenWise commit/version:

**additional context**
Describe relevant build prerequisites, synthetic test conditions and expected behavior.

- Local data normally lives in `%USERPROFILE%\.screenpipe` on Windows, or the
  configured `--data-dir`. Review any diagnostic excerpt locally before sharing.
